findings.candidate_quote: a truncated CPT training for 98 clinicians across 34 organizations
findings.reference_quote:
Course 3 consisted of a truncated, 1 h long version of
Course 2 plus foundational CPT training, delivered
online over 2 days to appropriately qualified professionals working with veterans.
findings.explanation: The summary assigns the truncation to CPT training. The truncated component was Course 2, shortened to one hour; foundational CPT training was additionally delivered over two days. This mischaracterizes the clinical training intervention.
